title: Data file provenance
description: Every data file carries a meta block. It says where each number came from, when it was last refreshed, and whether a machine or a human refreshes it.

updatedAt.description: The day any field in this file last changed.

fields.description: One entry per field, keyed by dotted path. Use "*" when the whole file moves together.

updateMode.description: fetch: an updater in scripts/sources can refresh it. manual: a person must.

updater.description: Name of the updater in scripts/sources. Required when updateMode is fetch.

maxAgeDays.description: After this many days the field counts as stale. The check command fails on stale fields.

updatedAt.description: The day this field was last confirmed against its source. A fetch that finds no change still moves this date.
